events.pr_review_comment: a review comment was left on a pull request
events.pr_review: a pull request review was submitted
events.issue_comment: a comment was left on an issue or pull request
events.pull_request: a pull request was opened, closed, synchronized…
events.push: commits were pushed to a repository
events.task_stage_changed: a task entered a new stage

runs.missed_deadline: missed by {late}, past the {deadline} starting deadline
runs.running_check_failed: could not check for running runs: {err}
runs.still_going: a previous run is still going ({count} in flight)
runs.daemon_restarted: daemon restarted while the run was in flight
runs.chain_too_deep: the event is about a task opened by a chain of {max} automations, so it does not fire another one

errors.duration_not_string: duration must be a string like "15m"
errors.steps_required: at least one step is required
errors.trigger_missing: trigger must declare schedule, event, metric or manual
errors.trigger_ambiguous: trigger must declare exactly one of schedule/event/metric/manual
errors.filter_unknown_field: the filter reads trigger.payload.{field}, which {event} does not carry (it carries: {known})
errors.metric_trigger_target_required: metric trigger needs environment and metric
errors.metric_trigger_op: metric trigger op must be one of > >= < <=
errors.metric_trigger_agg: metric trigger agg must be avg|max|min|sum|last
errors.metric_trigger_every: metric trigger `every` must be at least 1m
errors.timeout_too_long: timeout above 1h — a recipe that long belongs on a board
errors.step_multiple_actions: step {step:%q} declares {count} actions, exactly one is allowed
errors.step_children_not_fanout: step {step:%q} has child steps but is not a fanout
errors.step_script_timeout: step {step:%q} script.timeout above {max} — a script that long belongs on a board
errors.step_fanout_nested: step {step:%q} nests a fanout inside a fanout — flatten it or use a board
errors.step_fanout_max_items_required: step {step:%q} needs fanout.max_items — an uncapped fanout is how one bad response opens fifty tasks
errors.cron_every_too_short: cron: @every must be at least 1m, got {got}
errors.cron_no_firing: cron: {expr:%q} has no firing in the next {days} days
errors.expr_bad_field: expr: bad field name after . at {pos}
errors.stopped_by_condition: automation: recipe stopped by a condition
errors.mcp_unavailable: mcp steps are not available on this install
errors.args_not_map: rendered args are {value:%T}, want a map
errors.credential_store_missing: credential {name:%q} requested but no credential store is wired
errors.script_unavailable: script steps are not available on this install
errors.task_query_unavailable: task queries are not available on this install
errors.metric_query_unavailable: metric queries are not available on this install
errors.task_unavailable: task steps are not available on this install
errors.mention_unavailable: mention steps are not available on this install
errors.metric_trigger_missing: metric trigger without a metric block
errors.metric_trigger_unavailable: metric triggers are not available on this install
errors.yaml_unknown_key: line {line}: the key {key:%q} does not go here (check its spelling and indentation)
errors.yaml_wrong_type: line {line}: {value:%q} does not fit here, it takes {want}

log.release_fingerprint: automation: release fingerprint {fingerprint} after a failed create
log.parked_runs: parked {count} run(s) interrupted by a restart
